meta.title: Spiraldynamik Practice – Therapy & Courses for Healthy Movement
meta.description: Spiraldynamik practice: physiotherapy, movement analysis and courses for feet, back and joints. Movement that fits the human body.

hero.lead: Pain rarely appears by chance. We analyse how you move, explain what we find and train a movement pattern that takes the load off your joints – step by step, practical and lasting.

about.title: Spiraldynamik – understanding anatomy in motion
about.lead: Spiraldynamik is a movement and therapy concept that reads the human body as a three-dimensional spiral. Once you understand how foot, pelvis and spine work together, you can correct harmful loading patterns instead of treating symptoms alone.

features.title: Cause, not symptom
features.text: We look where the pain originates: in posture, gait and habit. Treatment starts with the quality of your movement.

features.title: Explained clearly
features.text: Models and images show you what happens inside your body. Understanding is the first step towards change.

features.title: Exercises for everyday life
features.text: Short, precise exercises that fit into your day – while walking, sitting and working.

features.title: Lasting results
features.text: The goal is not the next session but your independence. You should be able to steer your own movement long term.

offer.title: Therapy and courses
offer.lead: One-to-one therapy for specific complaints, courses for everyone who wants to improve the way they move.
offer.empty: Nothing is listed for this selection at the moment.

items.title: Movement analysis & first assessment
items.text: Detailed history, gait analysis and functional testing. Together we define your goal and the way there.

items.title: Physiotherapy based on Spiraldynamik
items.text: Manual techniques combined with active movement learning for back, knee and shoulder complaints.

items.title: Foot & gait analysis
items.text: Hallux valgus, flat and splay feet, heel spur: we rebuild the arch of your foot functionally.

items.title: Healthy feet
items.text: Six evenings on arches, rolling motion and choosing footwear. Includes a home exercise programme.

items.title: Back in balance
items.text: Upright without effort: spine, pelvis and breathing working together.

items.title: Active at the office
items.text: Compact course for working days – sitting, standing, screen work. Also available for companies.

approach.title: How we work together
approach.lead: A clear path from the first conversation to your own independent practice.

steps.title: Getting to know
steps.text: In the first conversation we clarify your complaints, your goals and your daily routine.

steps.title: Analysing
steps.text: Gait, posture and mobility are examined and explained in plain language.

steps.title: Practising
steps.text: You receive a personal exercise plan and learn to perform the movements precisely.

steps.title: Consolidating
steps.text: In follow-up sessions or in a course we anchor the new pattern in your everyday life.

contact.title: Book an appointment
contact.lead: Send us a message or give us a call – we usually reply within one working day.
